proposal.summary: A specially crafted PDF with an excessively large page size can trigger a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code, found via fuzz testing.
proposal.cwe_quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request from the reporter a) the affected Xpdf version(s) and b) a proof-of-concept file or reproduction steps; if reproducible, assign to the Xpdf engineering team to fix the divide-by-zero and add bounds checks for page size.

evidence_quotes.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
